hooks.name: Lock Payment Receipt Mockups
hooks.description: Prevents accidental modification of the approved payment receipt and signature management mockup files.

action.prompt:
If the tool is attempting to modify, overwrite, or delete any of these files, you MUST deny the operation and inform the user that these mockups are locked:
- .kiro/docs/mockups/payment-receipt-list.html
- .kiro/docs/mockups/payment-receipt-document.html
- .kiro/docs/mockups/signature-management.html

These files are approved mockups and must not be changed without explicit user permission to unlock them.
